author: C++ Weekly With Jason Turner
description:
Summary:

In this episode Mathieu and Jason are joined by Jon Bauman to discuss safety and interoperability between Rust and C++. We go into what does “safety” really mean (there are several categories of safety) and what can be guaranteed or not, and how to improve safety in C++.

Jon is currently looking for sponsorship to continue this important work. You can contact Jon via Joncppcast@shumi.org

Check out the extensive list of links and notes for this episode.

Guest Bio:

Jon Bauman has worked in tech for over two decades across various industries and programming disciplines. After several decades trying out prescriptivism, they prefer descriptivism and not bundling gender metadata with 3rd person pronouns. But  they will not mind at all if you call them "him", or even "her".
